name: splat_sor
summary: Remove floaters from a trained splat with local-density or global statistical outlier removal, with hold-to-compare A/B.
description: Post-training floater cleanup. Local density detection compares each Gaussian with its own neighbourhood, so it catches floaters hugging thin detail like cables, spokes and grass that classic SOR misses; global SOR uses one scene-wide threshold for floaters in open space. Limit the analysis to the current selection, optionally prune low-opacity Gaussians, then hold a button to A/B the result in the viewport before baking. Non-destructive: outliers are soft-deleted and restorable until you bake them.
author: felixgeen
